environment.description: AWS Lambda in Step Functions workflow. PostgreSQL RDS instance with database user 'oauth_reader_v2' configured via pg_hba.conf with hostssl entry restricting to specific Lambda security group CIDR. The database role has been granted through a chain: role 'app_readonly_base' inherits from 'pg_read_all_data' (PostgreSQL 14+ predefined role), and 'oauth_reader_v2' inherits from 'app_readonly_base' with NOINHERIT on any write-capable roles. Explicit REVOKE INSERT, UPDATE, DELETE ON ALL TABLES IN SCHEMA public FROM oauth_reader_v2 was applied, plus a default privilege alteration (ALTER DEFAULT PRIVILEGES IN SCHEMA public REVOKE INSERT, UPDATE, DELETE ON TABLES FROM oauth_reader_v2). The Step Functions state machine definition uses a Map state with ResultSelector that strips Location headers from the Lambda output before passing to the next integration state, though the API Gateway response mapping still returns the raw Lambda response to the caller.

config.db_role_chain: oauth_reader_v2 -> app_readonly_base -> pg_read_all_data (NOINHERIT on write roles)
config.db_permissions: SELECT only via pg_read_all_data inheritance; explicit REVOKE INSERT,UPDATE,DELETE on all current and future tables
config.db_default_privileges: ALTER DEFAULT PRIVILEGES IN SCHEMA public REVOKE INSERT, UPDATE, DELETE ON TABLES FROM oauth_reader_v2
config.api_gateway: REST API with Lambda proxy integration, response passthrough enabled
